(1) regularizing state transitions in a hidden Markov model provides smooth transitioning among latent states, such that sequences are split into contiguous segments, (2) our methods are able to perfectly capture change in human activity data for half of the test cases, with an average variation of information score of 0.94, and (3) our methods provide simple replacements for standard hidden markov model update rules and can be used with standard expectation maximization algorithms for parameter estimation.
